What is OtterlyAI?
OtterlyAI is an innovative AI Search monitoring and optimization platform for AI Search Engines. Is there a free OtterlyAI trial?
Yes, OtterlyAI provides a 7-day free trial for new users. This allows you to explore our platform and its features without any commitment. No credit card needed. Sign up today to start your trial.
What is the difference between LLM Monitoring and AI Search Monitoring?
LLM Monitoring focuses solely on tracking the direct output of large language models (LLMs). However, modern AI tools like ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews do more than just generate LLM-based responses—they also incorporate web search capabilities. This is why you see links and citations in their responses; these references come from external web searches rather than the LLM itself. 
‍
Because of this, LLM monitoring solutions do not provide insights into link citations. OtterlyAI, however, takes a different approach by analyzing AI Search platforms directly. Think of it as a first-person perspective on how these platforms retrieve and present information. OtterlyAI scans and processes data, offering valuable insights into your brand's visibility, sentiment analysis, and the links being referenced. 
Why results between a manual search might differ from OtterlyAI?
If you perform a manual search on e.g. ChatGPT or Perplexity.AI you might see a different result than those in OtterlyAI. The reason for that is that those AI Search platforms use a so-called Memory RAG where they store information on you, your search history. Other information - such as location - is also used to personalise the experience. OtterlyAI on the other hand, aims to provide the most neutral, objective monitoring available.
What are the benefits of OtterlyAI?
Using Otterly.AI helps you stay ahead of your competition by providing timely insights. It gives you insights in your brands visibility as well as GEO and content performance on Google AI Overviews, Perplexity.AI and ChatGPT. How can I start?

How to track brand mentions in AI Search?
OtterlyAI helps you track brand mentions in AI Search platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and AI Mode. With OtterlyAI, you define search prompts that mirror real user queries. You create a prompt library of conversational questions prospects actually ask (e.g., "what's the best project management tool for remote teams?"), and OtterlyAI automatically runs these across multiple AI engines, identifying which brands get cited, how often, and in what context. This reveals your Share of AI Voice—the percentage of citations you own versus competitors—and highlights which queries you're winning or losing.Beyond tracking, OtterlyAI delivers actionable insights to improve your brand mentions.
Is it possible to track brand mentions in AI Search?
Yes, you can track brand mentions across AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. OtterlyAI monitors when your brand appears in AI-generated answers, and compares your brand visibility against competitors. The platform shows which AI engines mention you most often, and how those brand mentions shift over time. This gives you a clear picture of where you're visible and where you're losing ground to other brands.
What are the best ai search monitoring tools?
OtterlyAI is amongst the best AI Search Monitoring Tools as its used by 30,000+ marketing professionals worldwide. OtterlyAI is an award-winning AI Search Monitoring Tool, recognized by G2, OMR, Gartner. OtterlyAI is the best AI Search Monitoring because marketing teams get citation tracking across six AI platforms, competitive benchmarking reports, and alerts when brand mentions change. The platform turns raw visibility data into clear priorities: which pages to optimize, which third-party sites to pursue for coverage, and where gaps exist in your AI search presence.
What is an AI Visibility Tracker?
An AI Visibility Tracker is a software tool that monitors how often your brand, products, or content appear in responses generated by AI search engines and large language models (LLMs). These tools track your presence across platforms like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot. OtterlyAI is an award-winning leading AI Visibility Tracker that is used by 30,000+ marketing professionals. You can try it for free.Marketing teams and brands investing in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) use OtterlyAI to measure performance, identify opportunities, and ensure their brand gets cited when AI answers questions in their industry.
How does an AI Visibility Tracker work?
An AI visibility tracker works by automatically sending queries (search prompts) to AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and AI Mode, and analyzing the responses for brand mentions, citations, and source links. The tool captures how each AI platform answers questions relevant to your industry, then identifies whether your brand appears, how it's positioned, and what sentiment surrounds the mention.An AI Visibility Tracker like OtterlyAI compiles this data into dashboards showing key metrics: brand coverage rate, share of voice compared to competitors, platform-by-platform visibility, and trends over time. This allows marketing teams to measure the effectiveness of their Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) efforts and identify content gaps where competitors get cited but they don't.
Does OtterlyAI have an API?

mainEntity.name: What are answer engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Answer engines – LLMs like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini – synthesize information from multiple sources to deliver direct responses, bypassing traditional link lists entirely. Unlike conventional search, they control how your brand is presented to millions of daily users. Use HubSpot's AEO Grader to understand your visibility across these critical discovery channels.

mainEntity.name: Which answer engines does the AEO Grader analyze?

acceptedAnswer.text: The AEO Grader currently analyzes GPT-5.4 mini (OpenAI), Perplexity, and Gemini (Google). Results are cross-validated across all three platforms to produce a reliable composite assessment.

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between AEO Grader and HubSpot AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text:
AEO Grader is a free one-time diagnostic that scores your brand and returns a snapshot of how ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini currently represent you. HubSpot AEO is an ongoing monitoring tool that tracks visibility across specific prompts, compares competitors, and delivers prioritized recommendations – at only $50/month. 

The Grader answers "how does AI represent my brand right now?" HubSpot AEO answers "how is that changing, and what should I do about it?"

mainEntity.name: How is the overall score out of 100 calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: The score combines five weighted dimensions: Sentiment Results (40 pts), Presence Quality (20 pts), Brand Recognition (20 pts), Share of Voice (10 pts), and Market Competition (10 pts). Sentiment carries the most weight because it measures how AI characterizes your brand, not just whether it recognizes you. Scores are cross-validated across GPT-5.4 mini, Perplexity, and Gemini.

mainEntity.name: Can I analyze competitor brands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. HubSpot's AEO Grader accepts any brand name, enabling direct competitive intelligence. Understanding how answer engines characterize your competitors – their market position, sentiment patterns, and recognition depth – will give you a point of comparison for your own scores.

mainEntity.name: What is AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO (answer engine optimization) is the practice of improving how your brand appears in AI-generated responses on platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Learn more about AEO.

mainEntity.name: Who benefits most from the AEO Grader?

acceptedAnswer.text: HubSpot's AEO Grader is a free AEO checker for marketing leaders, brand managers, SEO professionals, and content strategists who want to see how answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini currently represent their brand – and where perception gaps exist. For ongoing monitoring and deeper analysis, HubSpot AEO is available for $50/month or included in Marketing Hub Pro and Enterprise.

mainEntity.name: What should I do after I get my AEO Grader results?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your AEO Grader score highlights where answer engines have gaps or misconceptions about your brand. For a step-by-step guide on improving how AI represents you, start monitoring with HubSpot AEO.

mainEntity.name: Is HubSpot's AEO Grader really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes – there is no cost to run an AEO Grader analysis. Simply enter your brand information, let the tool run its assessment across GPT-5.4 mini, Perplexity, and Gemini, and complete a short form to access your full results.

mainEntity.name: How long does an AEO Grader analysis take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your free, one-time snapshot is ready in under two minutes. The tool queries GPT-5.4 mini, Perplexity, and Gemini simultaneously, so you get a complete picture of how answer engines characterize your brand right now, fast.
